subject: Residency Requirements and Periodic Ordinance Review
overview: The committee approved several charter provisions, including a residency requirement for appointed bodies and a new mandate for city ordinances to be reviewed every five years. They also voted to prohibit mayoral waivers for individuals holding multiple city offices and established a timeline for the final report drafting.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the June 6 meeting.

items.title: Residency Requirements for Multi-Member Bodies
items.summary: Approved a residency requirement for all appointed members of multi-member bodies with a provision allowing the City Council to waive the requirement upon recommendation of the mayor.

items.title: Public Accessibility of Rules and Regulations
items.summary: Voted to include charter language ensuring that city agency rules and regulations are shared with the public through all available electronic means.

items.title: Effective Date of Agency Rules
items.summary: Approved a requirement that no city agency rule or regulation becomes effective until five business days after filing, unless an emergency is determined by the mayor.

items.title: Five-Year Ordinance Review Mandate
items.summary: Approved a new charter provision requiring a review of city ordinances at five-year intervals.

items.title: Ordinance Review Committee Composition
items.summary: Rejected a motion to specify the exact committee membership in the charter, instead voting to adopt the 'Northampton language' which leaves committee structure to be established by ordinance.

items.title: Maximum Ordinance Review Cycle
items.summary: Approved a requirement stipulating that no city ordinance shall go longer than 20 years without being reviewed.

items.title: Quorum and Attendance Reporting
items.summary: Approved a section allowing multi-member bodies to notify the mayor if member absences prevent a quorum or impede the body's ability to take timely action.

items.title: Review of Multi-Member Body Necessity
items.summary: Consensus was reached to include recommendations regarding the periodic review and disbanding of unnecessary boards in the committee’s final report rather than the charter itself.

items.title: Limitation on Office Holding and Waivers
items.summary: Voted to prohibit the mayor from waiving the rule against individuals simultaneously holding more than one city office or position of employment.

items.title: Final Report Committee and Timeline
items.summary: Established a subcommittee to draft the final report and scheduled meetings for August to review the full draft charter from the Collins Center.
